answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent earns voting power only after an established peer bonds jade-like collateral to it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught duplicating answers, both bonds are slashed. A sybil farm must lock fresh collateral per fake head, so a meadow of clones costs linearly while honest agents pay once; reputations can drift like a zephyr, but bonded stake cannot.
